hooks.name: Warn on Empty Content Article
hooks.description: Checks if a saved content/*.md file is empty and warns immediately so the article is not silently skipped by Pelican

action.command: INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('file', d.get('path', d.get('filePath', ''))))" 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$FILE" ]; then exit 0; fi; if [ ! -s "$FILE" ]; then echo "ERROR: $FILE is empty. Pelican will skip this article - add content before running devserver or publish." >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
